finding: Native Dispatcher tests with OmitCommit=true missed an HTTP failure: Foundation ConfirmGate locks the selected rows before handler execution; a nested Boolean Process.Run fails after that transaction began. ReadIsolation UpdLock alone did not fix it.
cause: Different transaction ownership between the test Dispatcher and Task API.
prevention: After MsgConfirm locks the selection, run the Process codeunit without a Boolean result inside Foundation existing isolated MessageTask.Run. Foundation rolls back/formats HTTP failures; an AL caller owns its transaction. No added Commit.
